Dear traveller,

Our heritage holiday home is in Mazal Vaddo, Anjuna. There is a balcao to welcome you, carved furniture to admire and a garden pool for those wonderfully unplanned afternoons.

Let us know when you would like to visit. We’ll help you find the room that suits your stay.
